tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version Numbering Scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use Semantic Versioning (Semver), with versions in the major.minor.patch format. Semver was chosen because it signals backward compatibility explicitly, giving downstream consumers clearer expectations about API compatibility and the impact of each release at a glance.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
